entry.title: InCad 0.11.2: Holes and threads in several places at once
entry.content:
Added

  • Hole ▸ Concentric: click several round edges or round faces at once (Round) — a hole at the centre of each; the Face is optional.
  • Thread on several faces at once (holes or shafts): a thread on each with the same settings; afterwards each is a thread of its own.
  • Apply + opens the next dialog with the same settings (only the picks start empty), in every tool.

Fixed

  • Deleting a feature that others are built on (a Chamfer on a Fillet's edges) hung, then did nothing: InCad now asks to delete those too, as one undo step; No leaves the part as it was.
  • Thread in a second hole: the click on it (shown as the first thread's preview) was dropped.
